mu_name_note: Ours, not MU's: MU calls this model the Jewel of Creation. The user, 2026-09-28: "rename jewel of creation to rune of creation" -- it is the thing a +Rune item takes.
mu_name_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:1008: `AccessModel(MODEL_JEWEL_OF_CREATION, L"Data\\Item\\", L"jewel", 22)`, and _enum.h:2090 `MODEL_JEWEL_OF_CREATION = MODEL_POTION + 22` -- group 14, number 22. The file on disk is lower-case jewel22.bmd.
why_this_one: invention, and not a 0.75 row: the Jewel of Creation is Season 2's. The user, 2026-09-28: "we will use jewel of creation as runes". It is the epic jewel a +Rune item takes -- one power in it, rolled or given, set into the item's one Rune by dropping it on the item (sim/powers.h). Very rare by design: the first completion of a city quest gives one, never a repeat, and very high-end drops later. So it drops from nothing, and it is not flagged a jewel either -- the jewel flag is what the drop's jewel group counts, and a row there with no drop level would fall in Lorencia.
tells_note: Empty on purpose: what the jewel does is its power's, which the card prints from sim/powers.h, and a row carries one line for every jewel of its kind.

stats.note: Group and number are MU's; the rest is ours. The footprint is the jewels' one cell.
stats.jewel_note: Not flagged. See why_this_one: the flag enters the drop's jewel group.

sheet_from: Data/Item/red_jewel.OZJ and blue_jewel.OZJ, from MuMain's own bin/Data: jewel22.bmd names red_jewel.jpg on 24 triangles and blue_jewel.jpg on 12. Both are eight texels square, a pink-red (255,100,178 on average) and a blue-violet (140,129,254).
cutout_from: No alpha in either .OZJ, and the mesh is a closed solid.
flat_shaded_why: As the other jewels: a cut stone is its facets.
material_note: glass on both islands, as Jewel01, 02 and 15: a gem is a dielectric.
upright_from: As the other jewels: shown as authored, point down and point up.
